scores.rationale: The candidate uses completely wrong frame and type names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`) instead of the specified `list_conversations` and `conversation_list`. It completely omits the `transport.history: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in configuration, making the feature always on by default, and fails to add `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`. Furthermore, when a store does not implement `listFor`, the candidate returns an empty list (`sessions: []`), which explicitly violates a core requirement and acceptance criterion stating it must return an `UNSUPPORTED` error and never an empty list. It also accepts `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` (whereas the ticket specifies integer 1–200), logs raw store error messages (risking credential leaks), and misses updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`.
